Trigger A creature attempts to Strike you while you are off-guard due to Queen's Gambit.

Your follower @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Bcxarzksqt9ezrs6]{Strides} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VjxZFuUXrCU94MWR]{Strikes} the triggering creature. If the creature failed its Strike, the follower gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their Strike; on a critical failure, a +2 circumstance bonus. The Strike deals additional precision damage equal to [[/r (floor(@actor.level/2))d6[precision]]] (1d6 per 2 of your levels).
